verdict.rationale: Baseten has a public pricing-and-limits docs page stating that Model APIs bill by token, with cached input tokens at a discounted rate. Budgets, usage queries and limit increases are self-serve through a form, so no sales call is implied. However, the evidence never shows actual per-token price figures, or a price list covering every hosted model. Missing for 10: concrete published per-token rates, confirmation that prices are listed for every hosted model, and independent corroboration that pricing is transparent without contacting sales.
